claim_scope: post-hoc mechanism observation on one consumed development case

trajectory_observations.event: the declared test extra was unavailable because its exact lightning-thunder development release had disappeared from the current index
trajectory_observations.inference: provider availability is an observed constraint rather than evidence that the whole deployment plan is infeasible

trajectory_observations.event: an all-extra installation timed out after materializing substantial package state; immediate replay then failed on a missing generated executable and direct probes showed a partially useful but inconsistent environment
trajectory_observations.inference: a timed-out transition can contain both satisfied postconditions and state damage, so shell status alone cannot decide whether state is reusable

trajectory_observations.event: the same installation completed in 66.9 seconds from the partially materialized state
trajectory_observations.inference: verified state reuse can amortize expensive acquisition, but only after explicit postcondition checks

trajectory_observations.event: the agent migrated from the base Python 3.13 environment to a repository-local Python 3.11 environment, then repaired one setuptools compatibility failure without rebuilding the environment
trajectory_observations.inference: runtime migration and suffix repair are state transformations, not reasons to replay every successful operation

cross_trajectory_interpretation.river_replication: both external trajectories separate command outcome from resulting environment state
cross_trajectory_interpretation.new_distinction: LitGPT shows that preserved state may be useful, damaged, or still unknown; preservation therefore requires postcondition evidence rather than a successful exit code
cross_trajectory_interpretation.mechanism_hypothesis: search in a persistent construction state, admit only postcondition-verified state transformations, and certify the synthesized complete program once in a clean environment
cross_trajectory_interpretation.next_external_baseline: Repo2Run after OPENAI_API_KEY is explicitly exported into the run environment
